facts.business: Vega Jewellers Limited is engaged in the design and retail of fine jewellery, including gold, diamond, platinum, and gemstone collections, operating retail stores across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh with limited exports to the USA.

auditor.name: M/s. Sudheer Chunduru & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Macroeconomic headwinds including geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, elevated inflation, global monetary tightening and economic slowdown threatening discretionary consumer spending
Intense competition from organized and unorganized market participants risking market share and revenue stability
Profitability heavily reliant on gold jewellery segment; supply disruptions or adverse gold price fluctuations pose material financial risk
